tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the South African fresh fruit categories covered by this reference data, with HS heading and origin. Industry data, not a stock list. No prices or volumes.

tools.name: get_season
tools.description: South African export season window for a product (ISO weeks / months), each line labelled Fact or Inference with its source. Omit product_id for all products.

tools.name: get_specs
tools.description: Cultivars, origin regions, grade classes, official size codes/minimum sizes, carton reporting units and pack codes for a product, each labelled Fact or Inference with sources. Traded count ranges and some cartons are pending.

tools.name: contact_route
tools.description: How to reach FlowFresh with enquiries about this reference data (information only; FlowFresh does not buy, sell or broker fruit).

tools.name: get_market_access
tools.description: Plant-health market-access notes for a South African fruit to a destination: whether it can enter, phytosanitary certificate and permit steps, protocol requirements and cold treatment. Each line is labelled Fact, Inference or pending, with dated sources (EU, UK, Russia/EAEU, UAE, Saudi Arabia, China
